description: Long-form bench S3 (dialogue walk): templates/minimax/chained-segments with continuity 'guide' and carry_audio, six segments, a cast portrait (asset:bench/walker.png) and one short spoken line per segment through `prompts`. Each line is sized to a segment (see plugins/dw/skills/minimax-h3/references/dialogue.md). `anchor` and `guide_noise` are the drift-probe knobs; their defaults are today's call.
